{{Top|leg}}
'''Tramp shuttle''' was a slang term used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to refer to any civilian [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] that they modified into a combat [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Tramp shuttles were of a variety of makes and models, reflecting the fact that the Alliance made do with whatever they could get their hands on. These tramp shuttles generally could not carry as many [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] into battle as a [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] could, but they were intended to deliver them directly into hot combat zones, requiring them to be fast and agile. The Alliance used a number of modified [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeders]] as tramp shuttles during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
